title: Jeremiah Bible Quiz - Chapter 34
description: Ten questions on Jeremiah 34: the word to Zedekiah, the covenant to set the Hebrew servants free, and the liberty proclaimed when that covenant was broken.

questions.text: What was Jeremiah told to say to Zedekiah about this city?
questions.explanation: Yahweh told Jeremiah to tell Zedekiah that he would give this city into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he would burn it with fire.

answers.text: That it would be spared for David's sake
That its walls would be rebuilt in seven years
That it would be given to the king of Babylon, who would burn it
That Egypt would come up and deliver it

questions.text: What did Yahweh say about the way Zedekiah would die?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said concerning Zedekiah, "You won't die by the sword. You will die in peace," and that they would make a burning for him as for the former kings.

answers.text: That he would not die by the sword but die in peace
That he would be killed in the middle gate
That he would die of famine in the city
That he would fall by the hand of his princes

questions.text: Which cities of Judah still remained as fortified cities when Jeremiah spoke to Zedekiah?
questions.explanation: The king of Babylon's army was fighting against Jerusalem and against Lachish and Azekah, for these alone remained of the cities of Judah as fortified cities.

answers.text: Bethlehem and Anathoth
Mizpah and Ramah
Gibeon and Shiloh
Lachish and Azekah

questions.text: What covenant had king Zedekiah made with all the people at Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: Zedekiah made a covenant to proclaim liberty, that every man should let his Hebrew male servant and female servant go free, and make bondservants of them no more.

answers.text: To tear down the high places of Baal
To let their Hebrew male and female servants go free
To bring tithes into Yahweh's house
To send no messengers to Egypt

questions.text: What did the princes and the people do after they had let their servants go?
questions.explanation: Afterwards they turned and caused the servants and the handmaids whom they had let go free to return, and brought them into subjection again.

answers.text: They gave them fields and vineyards
They sent them away to Babylon
They brought them back into subjection
They made a second covenant before Yahweh

questions.text: In the covenant God made when he brought the fathers out of Egypt, when was a man to release his Hebrew brother?
questions.explanation: The covenant said that at the end of seven years every man should release his Hebrew brother who had been sold to him and had served him six years.

answers.text: At the end of seven years
In the first month of each year
Whenever the servant asked for it
After one year of service

questions.text: Where had the people made this covenant, which they then profaned?
questions.explanation: They had made the covenant before Yahweh in the house which is called by his name, and then turned and profaned his name.

answers.text: At the gate of the king's garden
In the valley of the son of Hinnom
On the road that goes down to Egypt
In the house which is called by his name

questions.text: Since they would not proclaim liberty, what liberty did Yahweh proclaim to them?
questions.explanation: Because they had not listened and proclaimed liberty to one another, Yahweh proclaimed to them a liberty to the sword, to the pestilence, and to the famine.

answers.text: A liberty to go out to the Chaldeans
A liberty to the sword, the pestilence and the famine
A liberty to leave the land for Egypt
A liberty to serve other gods in exile

questions.text: What had the men who transgressed the covenant done when they made it?
questions.explanation: Yahweh spoke of the men who had not performed the words of the covenant which they made before him, when they cut the calf in two and passed between its parts.

answers.text: They cut a calf in two and passed between its parts
They poured out water before Yahweh
They set up a pillar of great stones
They burned incense on the roofs of their houses

questions.text: What did Yahweh say would happen to the dead bodies of those he gave into the hand of their enemies?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said he would give them into the hand of their enemies, and their dead bodies would be food for the birds of the sky and for the animals of the earth.

answers.text: They would be carried to Babylon
They would be buried in the king's garden
They would be food for the birds and the animals
They would be burned in the valley of Hinnom
